description: This file implements the CommandParser class for parsing AT commands in a modem simulator, including methods for extracting strings and integers from command strings.

classes.name: CommandParser
classes.description: A class for parsing AT command strings in a modem simulator context.

methods.name: GetNextStr
methods.description: Parses the next string between double quotes in the command string.

methods.name: GetNextStr(char flag)
methods.description: Parses the substring before a specified flag character.

methods.name: GetNextStrDeciToHex
methods.description: Converts the next decimal integer in the command to an uppercase hexadecimal string.

methods.name: GetNextInt
methods.description: Parses the next decimal integer from the command string.

methods.name: GetNextHexInt
methods.description: Parses the next hexadecimal integer from the command string.
